messages:
Maya P.: Quick intake — bringing up newt-8b-quant (int8) for hosted + dedicated + a few private pilots. Baseline: eval suite passes overall but small regressions on long-context QAs. Perf: +6% median latency, p95 up ~8%, cost estimate -40% per token. Need a phased release + fallback checklist.
Javier R.: Sounds good. Proposed phased release: smoke -> internal beta -> limited production -> ramp. Different policies per deployment mode. Short checklist per stage?
Lena C.: Yup. Smoke: inference sanity, simple prompt set, 5-10k token budget, check KV cache correctness. Command to run quick smoke curl: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"newt-8b-quant","prompt":"Summarize: ..."}'`
Chris W.: For internal beta (20 devs): run the full eval harness (n=2k prompts), measure quality delta: ROUGE / exact-match / hallucination rate. Gate: quality delta <= 1.0% on primary metric OR explicit sign-off from eval owner.
Priya S.: Production-limited (hosted): traffic split plan: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 30% over windows 30m/1h/2h/6h if metrics stable. For dedicated: schedule reserved pool before >10% to avoid cold-starts.
Maya P.: Important: fallback variants list. Primary fallback -> newt-8b-fp16 (same weights) ; secondary fallback -> raven-13b-compat (higher cost). For private installs, fallback must be pre-approved by customer.
Javier R.: Monitoring to watch: p95 latency, median latency, error rate (5xx + timeouts), token throughput, mean log prob on eval set, hallucination signal (manual labels), and cost per token. Add a synthetic prompt set for regression detection.
Lena C.: Automate canary gates in the pipeline: `canary_check --model newt-8b-quant --baseline newt-8b-fp16 --metrics latency_p95<=1.15, error_rate<=0.5%, quality_delta<=1.5% --window 30m`
ops-bot: deploy started: newt-8b-quant -> hosted-stack-a (image: newt-8b-quant:v1). Tracking ID: DPL-1806237890 :rocket:
Chris W.: Rollback conditions (immediate): error_rate > 0.5% absolute OR p95 latency > baseline * 1.25 OR quality_delta > 2.0% on the evaluation suite. Soft-fail: anomalies that persist > 2h -> manual review, hold ramp.
Priya S.: Emergency rollback command for hosted: `redwoodctl rollout undo --model newt-8b-quant --to newt-8b-fp16` Dedicated rollback: `redwood-dedicated rollback --pool newt-pool --target newt-8b-fp16`
Maya P.: Security & private notes: ensure KMS key is present for private tenants, verify TLS & VPC peering, confirm that audit logs are streamed to customer S3. Document data handling in the onboarding ticket.
Javier R.: Ops checklist before any >10% shift: load test at target qps for 1h, verify autoscale reacts, confirm GPU occupancy and token-latency curves. If memory pressure observed, revert to fp16 or reduce batch sizes.
sre-oncall: Add SLOs to monitor: user-visible latency alert (p95 > 600ms for 2min), error-rate alert (>0.5% for 5min), and cost spike alert (>50% util change). Pager policy: oncall if any immediate rollback triggers.
Lena C.: Post-release evaluation: run expanded eval (10k prompts) after 24h and 7d windows. Create ticket if drift on customer-critical prompt sets. Tag model with `release/newt-8b-quant/2026-03`.
Maya P.: Great, I'll convert this to the release checklist and add to the onboarding ticket. @Priya S. can you schedule reserved capacity for dedicated pilot? :eyes:
Priya S.: On it, scheduling now. Will post capacity ETA and reservation ID.
deploy-bot: canary ramp event: newt-8b-quant -> 2% after 30m. Monitoring pipeline enabled.
Maya P.: Thanks everyone — final: I'll attach the smoke test logs and the eval diff to the ticket once the 2% window is green. If anyone wants to add specific prompts to the private pilot suite, drop them here. :thumbsup:
